title: Red, White & Royal Blue
author: Casey McQuiston
summary: The son of the US president and a British prince have a public feud, then a staged truce, then something neither can explain away. Their story plays out under the glare of two governments and a lot of tabloid attention.
readIf: You want a laugh-out-loud romcom with real feeling underneath.
skipIf: You prefer your romance without political backdrop or open-door scenes.

pairings.reason: Another banter-heavy romance about two rivals who see each other too clearly.
A tender love story with the same warmth and humour, set in a magical world.
